direct_official_checks: DTM 2m is a related dataset to DTM 1m
DTM 10m is also listed as a related dataset
2m metadata uses the same 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022 survey period
2m service exposes WCS as well as metadata index services
1m and 2m belong to the same composite product family
different grid resolution does not prove independent source acquisition
same-family products can be used for resolution consistency checks
same-family products must not be counted as independent corroboration without lineage evidence
quality_effect: Prevents false confidence from treating EA 1m/2m/10m products as independent evidence when lineage may be shared.
